column7: evidencesink webhook dial-time guard isDisallowedIP did not decode embedded IPv4 (NAT64 64:ff9b::/96 and 64:ff9b:1::/96, IPv4-compatible ::x, 6to4, Teredo), so encodings of private, link-local and cloud-IMDS IPv4 that siem and the netutil reference refuse passed (25 bypasses). Fixed by delegating to netutil.IsPrivateOrLinkLocalExceptLoopback; found by the V7 egress-guard parity harness (FuzzEgressGuardParity), PR #4143 finding F1
